p.m.

CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. A maximum of two time donations per speaker is allowed (no more than 9 minutes total); the person donating time must be present. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
8A.
Approval to waive the full reading of the text of all ordinances and resolutions introduced/adopted at this meeting. Ordinances and resolutions shall be introduced/adopted by title only. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve.
8B.
Approval of the Minutes of the August 28, 2024, Special-Closed Session Meeting; and September 11, 2024, Special-Closed Session Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2024-09-25 Item 08B Minutes
8C.
Approval of the Warrants List (Register of Demands). Contact Person: Finance Manager Dinh
Staff recommends that the City Council review and approve the warrants.
2024-09-25 Item 08C Approval of Warrants List
8D.
Memorandum of Understanding between the City of Encinitas and the Encinitas Chamber of Commerce for a community special event. Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the City Council is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Contact Person: Recreation Services Manager Hamer
Approve and authorize the City Manager in coordination with the City Attorney, to execute a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) in substantial form, between the City of Encinitas and the Encinitas Chamber of Commerce to provide a Business and Community Resource Expo scheduled for Saturday, February 8, 2025, at the Encinitas Community and Senior Center.
2024-09-25 Item 08D Chamber of Commerce MOU
8E.
Second reading and adoption of Ordinance No. 2024-08 for the adoption of the El Camino Real Specific Plan (ECRSP) and related amendments to the Encinitas Zoning Regulations, and the Local Coastal Program. Environmental Considerations: Pursuant to California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Guidelines Section 15105(b), an Initial Study (IS) has been prepared which determined that no significant environmental impacts would result from the proposed project with mitigation measures incorporated into the project. Therefore, a Mitigated Negative Declaration (MND) was prepared for the project that includes mitigation measures for Biological Resources (BIO-1) and Tribal Cultural Resources (TCR-1) incorporated into the project as filed with the State Clearinghouse (State Clearinghouse No. 2024060039), and San Diego County Clerk-Recorder's Office. The City Council approved the Mitigated Negative Declaration and Mitigation Monitoring and Reporting Program on September 11, 2024 (Resolution No. 2024-83). Contact Person: Housing Services Manager Dacey
Adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2024-08, titled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, Adopting the El Camino Real Specific Plan (SP-6) and Amendments to Section 30.84.010 of Chapter 30.84 (Specific Plans) of the Zoning Regulations and the Local Coastal Program" with incorporation of recommended modifications as directed by City Council.
2024-09-25 Item 08E ECRSP Adoption
2024-09-25 Item 08E ECRSP Adoption - Public Comment
8F.
San Diego Association of Governments (SANDAG) Housing Acceleration Program (HAP) Grant Cycle 2 Award in the amount of $573,000, budget amendment to appropriate funds to the 6th Cycle Housing Element Implementation Program (WC22C) work project, and authorization to execute a contract and contract amendment to fulfill the grant requirements. Environmental Considerations: The action before the City Council is not subject to the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to Section 15060(c)(3) of the CEQA Guidelines since the action is not a "project" pursuant to Section 15378(b)(5). The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in a direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Contact Person: Associate Planner Cvetko
1) Receive SANDAG HAP Grant Award in the amount of $573,000; 2) Adopt Resolution No. 2024-105, titled "A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, Amending the Fiscal Year 2024-25 Budget" appropriating HAP Grant funds to the 6th Cycle Housing Element Implementation Program (WC22C) work project"; 3) Authorize the City Manager in consultation with the City Attorney to execute a Professional Services Agreement with Ascent Environmental, Inc. in substantial form; and 4) Authorize the City Manager in consultation with the City Attorney to amend the Professional Services Agreement with Civic Solutions, Inc. (Contract #24300094) to add new grant funding to hire new contract planning and/or engineering staff in substantial form.
2024-09-25 Item 08F SANDAG HAP Grant Award
8G.
Acceptance of the AB-43 Speed Limit Signs (CS02F) and Citywide Speed Legends (CS02F) Projects. Environmental Considerations: The actions being considered by the City Council are exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because they are not "projects" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The actions involve an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Contact Person: Associate Traffic Engineer Barr
1) Authorize the filing of the Notices of Completion for the subject projects; 2) Authorize the release of the payment bonds for the subject projects in full upon the recording of the Notices of Completion; 3) Authorize the release of the performance bonds for the subject projects in full upon the recording of the Notices of Completion; 4) Authorize the release of maintenance bonds for the subject projects in full, one (1) year after the recording of the Notices of Completion; 5) Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2024-94, titled "A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, Accepting the Public Improvements for the AB-43 Speed Limit Signs Project (CS02F)"; and 6) Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2024-95, titled "A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, Accepting the Public Improvements for the Citywide Speed Legends Project (CS02F)."
2024-09-25 Item 08G NOC for AB43 Signs and Speed Legends
8H.
Adoption of Ordinance No. 2024-10, amending Ordinance No. 2024-02 to create a new comprehensive street list with additional and amended streets with lower speed limits in the City of Encinitas ("City") pursuant to Assembly Bill 43 (AB43). Environmental Considerations: The actions being considered by the City Council are exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because they are not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The actions involve organizational or administrative activities of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Contact Person: City Traffic Engineer Bandegan
Adopt Ordinance No. 2024-10, titled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, Amending Ordinance No. 2024-02, to Create a New Comprehensive Street List with Additional and Amended Streets with Lower Speed Limits in the City of Encinitas Pursuant to Provisions of Assembly Bill 43 (AB43)."
2024-09-25 Item 08H AB43 Ordinance Adoption
2024-09-25 Item 08H AB43 Ordinance Adoption - Public Comment
8I.
Amendment No. 1 to Contract with Blue Moon Management Corporation for Facility Janitorial and Lock-up Services. Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the City Council is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Elmore
Authorize the City Manager, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute an amendment to the contract with Blue Moon Management Corporation in substantial form, to incorporate facility janitorial services at the Pacific View Arts Center and to increase the value of the agreement by $114,996 for the initial term and $281,493 if all available extensions are executed, for a total not-to-exceed contract amount of $1,186,093 for the initial term and $2,578,342 if all available extensions are executed.
2024-09-25 Item 08I First Amendment to Agreement with Blue Moon Management
8J.
Amendment No. 1 to Agreement for Professional Consultant Services between the City of Encinitas and Michael Baker International to add $150,000 for additional support with as needed land surveying services for private land development projects and other City survey needs. Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the City Council are exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The action involves organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Contact Person: Principal Engineer Cabrera
Authorize the City Manager or her designee, in coordination with the City Attorney, to execute Amendment No. 1 to the Agreement with Michael Baker International, in substantial form, to add $150,000 of capacity to the design professional consultant agreement for a new not-to-exceed amount of $350,000, and to extend the term of the Agreement by one (1) additional one-year period to June 30, 2026.
2024-09-25 Item 08J Michael Baker As-Needed Land Survey Contract Amendment 1

Zero Waste Program Implementation Services Contracts. Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the City Council is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Contact Person: Solid Waste & Recycling Program Administrator Maechler
ProduceGood - $35,800, Solana Center for Environmental Innovation - $52,867, BCK Programs - $69,875, and I Love A Clean San Diego - $64,895; and 2) Authorize a total not-to-exceed amount of $687,208 over three (3) years for all four (4) contracts.
2024-09-25 Item 08K Zero Waste Implementation Contracts

1) Receive the report and provide direction to staff regarding the bills presented in this report; 2) Adopt Resolution No. 2024-110, titled "A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, Directing Staff to Initiate Amendments to the Zoning Regulations and Local Coastal Program to Incorporate State Legislative Changes Regarding Accessory Dwelling Units"; 3) Adopt Resolution No. 2024-111, titled "A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, Directing Staff to Initiate Amendments to the Zoning Regulations and Local Coastal Program to Implement State Legislative Changes Regarding Parking Requirements for Single-Family Residences Pursuant to Government Code Section 65863.5"; and 4) Adopt Resolution No. 2024-112, titled "A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, Directing Staff to Initiate Amendments to the Zoning Regulations and Local Coastal Program to Implement State Legislative Changes Regarding Density Bonus Law Pursuant to Government Code Section 65915."

Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
